caption: The drawing features four distinct objects arranged on a neutral, beige background. On the left side, there is a long-sleeved dress in a light grayish-white color, with a fitted bodice, buttoned down the front, a V-shaped neckline, and a full skirt. To the upper right of the dress is a bonnet rendered in shades of light and medium gray, adorned with vertical stripes and two long ribbon ties hanging down. Slightly below and to the right of the bonnet, there is a triangular shawl depicted in shades of tan and brown, with visible fringed edges. Beneath this shawl, in the lower right corner, is another triangular shawl, wrapped and tied, in darker brown tones, also showing a fringe along its edges. Each item is carefully shaded to suggest texture and volume, with no background elements or additional objects present. The artist’s name is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Dress
